To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quality focus of the business-to-business e-auctions is a complex issue.
the quality focus of the business-to-business model is an important consideration in the development of an organizational auction-based strategy.

The growth of business to business auctions presents the quality focused business organization with many opportunites and some serious challenges; and, in the context of business to business auction based strategies the absence of a quality focus has the potential to erode organizational quality gain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a conceptual framework for the design and implementation of an e-business auction-based quality management strategy.
the development of a conceptual open systems approach designed to improve quality in e-business auction-based practices.
the development of a quality-focused open system model for e-business auction-based practices in business-to-business environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality-focused organization can benefit from the use of e-business auctions.
the quality of business-to-business e-auctioning is dependent on many factors, some of which are beyond the control of the business.
the business-to-business auctions are a powerful business tool that can be used to enhance the business quality focus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a conceptual model for quality-focused business-to-business auctions, and have provided some initial insights into the model's potential application.
we have provided a framework to help business organizations to design and manage quality focused business-to-business auctions in a supply-chain context.

the quality-focused business-to-business auction-based model is an open system approach which is designed to improve the organizational quality focus in the context of the e-business auction-based business model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a quality-focused business-to-business e-auction strategy should be developed to improve the quality of the business-to-business auctions.
the open system approach advocated is quality focused and, as such, is consistent with the quality focus that is a hallmark of the business-to-business e-auction.
the quality focus of the business-to-business e-auction model can be improved by using a well-defined and quality-focused organizational e-business auction strategy.
